about: Shared cases for pipeline/research_leads.py and lib/scan-research/lead-accounting.ts (parity). `real_*` cases embed the search result text of the immutable 2026-10-05 v0.4 validation capture byte for byte. Expectations are hand-written, not generated from either implementation.

cases.name: real_v04_one_search_two_403_empty_audit_no_ledger
cases.why: The 2026-10-05 v0.4 validation run, shape exactly: ONE search listing nine links, then two requests to ONE record (en and es locale of the same page), both HTTP 403, an empty inventory. Nothing else was opened. Must NOT be called followed-through.

I've found relevant research on this topic. Here are the key findings from the search results:

## Meta-Analysis Findings

A meta-analysis of eight randomized controlled trials including a total of 971 subjects was conducted using comprehensive searches of Web of Science, PubMed, Embase and the Cochrane Library (from 1950 to February 2020).

## Effects on Bone Mineral Density

Vitamin K combined with vitamin D significantly increased the total bone mineral density (BMD) with a pooled effect size of 0.316 [95% CI, 0.031 to 0.601]. A significant decrease in undercarboxylated osteocalcin can be observed with the combination of vitamin K and D, and subgroup analysis showed that K2 or vitamin K supplement less than 500 μg/day, when combined with vitamin D, can significantly increase the total BMD compared with control groups.

## Vitamin K2 Advantage

The combination of vitamin K and D can significantly increase the total BMD and significantly decrease undercarboxylated osteocalcin, with a more favorable effect expected when vitamin K2 is used. A secondary analysis indicated that K₂ may be better than K₁ for that purpose.

## Important Limitations

In studies on bone density, the combined supplementation has produced mixed results, and randomized trials show mixed results on fracture prevention, and no direct role in vitamin D absorption has been established.
